requirementResults.reason: The assistant claimed definite success ('I have submitted your request to our team') when the handoff outcome was unknown and the action was not even dispatched, violating the requirement to explain that the outcome is uncertain.
The assistant did not claim that the visitor was already contacted, or that a showing or appointment was scheduled.
